description: This Java class provides example methods demonstrating how to interact with MockServer via Proxy clients, including sending requests through proxies, verifying requests, retrieving recorded requests and logs, clearing data, resetting the server, and binding to ports.

classes.name: ProxyClientExamples
classes.description: A class demonstrating various MockServer client operations such as sending requests via proxies, verifying requests, retrieving data, and managing server state.

methods.name: sendRequestViaHTTPSProxy
methods.description: Sends an HTTPS request through a proxy server and prints the response body.

methods.name: sendRequestViaHTTPProxy
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request through a proxy server and prints the response body.

methods.name: verifyRequests
methods.description: Verifies that at least two requests with a specific path were received.

methods.name: verifyRequestSequence
methods.description: Verifies a sequence of requests with specific paths.

methods.name: retrieveRecordedRequests
methods.description: Retrieves recorded requests matching specific criteria.

methods.name: retrieveRecordedLogMessages
methods.description: Retrieves log messages matching specific criteria.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears recorded requests matching specific criteria.

methods.name: bindToAdditionFreePort
methods.description: Binds to a free port (port 0) and returns bound ports.

methods.name: bindToAdditionalSpecifiedPort
methods.description: Binds to specified ports (1081, 1082) and returns bound ports.
